source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 76 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 76 was established by Ordinance No. 14838, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 17, 1975. Ordinance No. 14838 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. Ordinance No. 14838 was amended by Ordinance No. 19830, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 13, 1988, and Ordinance No. 20129, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 9, 1988. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 14838; 19830; 20129; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 76 is established on property generally located at the intersection of the north right-of- way line of Walnut Hill Road and the east right-of-way line of Rambler Road. The size of PD 76 is approximately 11.243 acres. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-76.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423) SEC. 51P-76.103.1.EXHIBITS. The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:
(1)Exhibit 76A: site/landscape plan.
(2)Exhibit 76B: as-built survey.
(3)Exhibit 76C: sign location plan. (Ord. 30420)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Utilization of the Property must generally be in conformance with a city plan commission approved site plan (Exhibit 76A) which is attached to and made a part of Ordinance No. 14838. [Note: An “as-built” survey was attached to Ordinance No. 20129 and is labelled Exhibit 76B for reference.] (Ord. Nos. 14838; 20129; 25423)

sections.title: Uses Permitted And Square Footage Of Each
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.105.USES PERMITTED AND SQUARE FOOTAGE OF EACH. sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-76.106.OFF-STREET PARKING. Off-street parking must be provided at the following ratios:
(1)Post office for Woodhill Medical Park - One space per 200 square feet.
(2)General office - One space per 300 square feet.
(3)Restaurant - One space per 100 square feet.
(4)Private recreation club - One space per 100 square feet.
(5)Medical office - One space per 150 square feet. 25423)
(6)Medical laboratory - One space per 300 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19830;

sections.title: Building Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.107.BUILDING HEIGHT. Building heights may not exceed a maximum height of 36 feet. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-76.108.SIGNS.
(a)Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII.
(b)A maximum of two monument signs are allowed along the Rambler Road frontage, with minimum setback of 10 feet.
(c)A maximum of one monument sign is allowed along the Walnut Hill Lane frontage, with minimum setback of 10 feet.
(d)A maximum of one monument sign is allowed at the corner of Rambler Road and Walnut Hill Lane, with a minimum setback of 10 feet. This sign may not impede on the visibility triangle.
(e)Monument signs may not exceed 85 square feet of the total structure or 30 feet active sign area as located on the attached, sign location plan (Exhibit 76C). (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423; 30420)

sections.title: Fire Lanes
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.109.FIRE LANES. Fire lanes must be provided as required by Section 16-61 of the Dallas Fire Code. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)

sections.title: Drainage And Utility Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.110.DRAINAGE AND UTILITY REQUIREMENTS. Drainage and utility requirements must comply with the requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.111.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development within this PD must be in compliance with the requirements of all departments of the city. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.112.LANDSCAPE PLAN. A city plan commission approved landscape plan (Exhibit 76A) is attached to and made a part of Ordinance No. 14838. Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan and must be maintained in a healthy and growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.113.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard City of Dallas specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-76.114.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. No certificate of occupancy may be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 14838; 25423)
